title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Collect and report relevant data.
3. Analyze patterns and trends.
4. Check adherence to regulations and limits.
5. Use valid methodologies and protocols.
6. Provide photographic or visual evidence.
7. Document exact times, dates, and locations.
8. Reference any applicable standards and guidelines.
9. Include meteorological data if applicable.
10. Describe the sources and nature of emissions.
11. Compare emissions data to baseline or standard levels.
12. Calculate the volume and concentration of pollutants.
13. Discuss the potential health and environmental impacts.
14. Report any incidents of non-compliance.
15. Develop a timeline of emission events.
16. Include data from multiple sources for verification.
17. Detail the approach for data collection and analysis.
18. Mention any outliers in the data and their potential causes.
19. Review and validate the findings with relevant experts.
20. Prepare a concise written summary.
21. Make recommendations for reduction or mitigation.
22.
